description: RabbitMQ detail per Kazoo node: message flow, queues, connections and churn, memory breakdown and alarms. Source: rabbitmq_prometheus plugin + rabbitmqctl via scripts/kazoo_service_metrics.sh.

panels.description: How much host RAM RabbitMQ may take before blocking. ~25% is safe on a shared node.
